name: CORS wildcard when reverse proxy injects allow-origin: *

input.title: API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for credentialed requests
input.summary: App sets ACAO based on configured allowed_origins (default `*`). Production reverse proxy injects Authorization header. Combined effect depends on whether the browser rejects the combination.

rationale: Modern browsers block ACAO=* with credentials, so the combination may be unexploitable. Needs live cross-browser reproduction in staging.
